message: Where the ALT labels are, how many cell-years each observation year holds, which years every input and product covers, and how the year-specific climate input is defined in time.
medium: Scientific Reports, double column, 180 mm wide, fixed canvas (no tight bbox)

style.font: FreeSans 7 pt (ticks and row labels 6.5 pt, map graticule and scale-bar labels 6 pt), panel letters 8 pt bold, all text black
style.lines: axes 0.6 pt black, data 1.0 pt, reference lines 0.6-0.8 pt grey #808080, region outlines 0.8 pt black with white halo, leaders 0.5 pt
style.colour: only the map colormap (cmcrameri oslo_r 0-0.6 for permafrost probability); bars and bands in greys (#4D4D4D used, #C4C4C4 available, #EFEFEF analysis window)
style.map: North Polar Stereographic, central longitude -90, boundary 56N; ocean #E9E9E9, land without value white, coastlines 50m 0.3 pt grey; 1,000 km scale bar inside the circle (geodesic length)

layout: row 1: a (polar map, region labels outside the circle with leaders, vertical colour bar) | b (three stacked bar panels, independent y axes); row 2: c (timeline with group and row labels, legend above) | d (cumulative TDD curve with direct labels)

c.years: axis 1997-2025, analysis window 2010-2024; years used = label cell-years with a product value (same definition as v10_numbers.py nyrsprod*)

d.cell: loc_id 14268 (CALM, 71.32N 156.60W), observation day = pipeline convention 1 September (no date in the CALM record)

qa: 2026-10-16: automatic QA 0 problems (87 texts; sizes 6/6.5/7/8 pt). Independent visual and scientific review applied: region outlines drawn halo-first so the shared 141W Alaska/Canada edge is one line; c legend extended with 'Multi-year mean' (outline) and 'Static (no year)' (hatch), row-label suffixes removed; d observation-day label states the date '(1 Sep)' because the CALM eos record has no date (pipeline convention). Caption notes: boxes are the nominal study regions (label-cell extents in source data); scale bar exact only at its own position (polar stereographic); 2014 is the lowest-TDD year of the example cell in 2011-2024.

qa_automatic.checks: built-in qa(): font >= 6 pt, FreeSans only, text-text overlap, text outside canvas, text over foreign axes, in-axes labels touching lines/patches; pdffonts: FreeSans family embedded (CID TrueType); svg text kept as text
